title: Critique: an explanatory gap may remain

statements.text: It seems conceivable that a field of cosmic consciousness is stirred into phase-locked patterns and yet no ordinary phenomenal states occur, which would leave an explanatory gap. Shani and Keppler grant that questions of conceivability are hard to settle.

sources.quote: conceive that all of these activities occur and yet no ordinary states of phenomenal consciousness take place
In response, we note first that questions of conceivability are hard to settle.
